'''Tristan Gruber''' is a Star Wars CCG player who finished 18th at [[October 2001 Livonia tournament]] on 20 October 2001 with [[Hidden Base / Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers|HB flip with matching pilots]], according to Andrew Ehret's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d3064">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-10-20-livonia-michigan-on-october-202001d3064/ livonia-michigan-on-october-202001], DeckTech (Andrew "Gwaihir" Ehret, 20 October 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-10-20-livonia-michigan-on-october-202001d3064/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
